findings.description: find_matching_orders in the neighboring module is invoked per pricing pass, repeating its quadratic scan; the same nested-loop hotspot shows up from this partition's call-site view.
findings.suggested_action: Replace the nested scan with a customer_id-keyed dictionary lookup.

findings.description: compute_price sorts the full discount list on every call although the list is static per invocation batch.
findings.suggested_action: Sort the discount list once at load time (or memoize the sorted copy) instead of on every compute_price call.
